name: Virtual Boy
description: Gunpei Yokoi's 1995 tabletop stereoscopic console, which showed red monochrome 3D images through a pair of oscillating mirrors. Uncomfortable and expensive, it was discontinued within about a year with 22 games released.

specs.graphics: Two Reflection Technology scanning red LED displays, 384×224 per eye

curiosities: It was never released in Europe.
The display used red LEDs, which were the cheapest and least power-hungry option at the time.
Its image is produced by a single column of LEDs per eye swept across the view by a vibrating mirror.
